title: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration…
description: A vulnerability in the UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration WordPress plugin before version 2.26.16.26 allows users with Subscriber roles to escalate privileges to administrator. This occurs because the plugin does not properly handle comment-like content within long SQL statements during database backup restoration, enabling SQL execution triggered by crafted content stored in user profiles.
